# TLDP

> TLDP is a logistics API: quote, ship, track and return across many couriers through one integration. Base URL `https://api.tybritelabs.com/logistics/v1`.

## Getting started

- [TLDP API](https://docs.tybritelabs.com/tldp/index.md): One API for logistics — quote, ship, track, and return across many couriers.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.tybritelabs.com/tldp/quickstart.md): From zero to your first tracked delivery.
- [Authentication](https://docs.tybritelabs.com/tldp/authentication.md): API keys: secret vs publishable, and test vs live.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.tybritelabs.com/tldp/webhooks.md): Receive realtime events at your own URL, and verify every delivery.

## How TLDP works

- [How TLDP Works](https://docs.tybritelabs.com/tldp/how-tldp-works/overview.md): The system behind the API: how a rate is priced, how a shipment reaches a rider, and what happens when something fails mid-delivery.
- [Pricing & Rate Quotes](https://docs.tybritelabs.com/tldp/how-tldp-works/pricing.md): How a quote is built from a courier's rate card: weight brackets, zone multipliers, the door-delivery distance overage, and what a quote commits to.
- [Agencies & White-Label](https://docs.tybritelabs.com/tldp/how-tldp-works/agencies.md): How an operator resells the logistics layer under its own brand: its own price list on both payer sides, its own processor and commission, branded invoices, its own domain, its own API keys and its own specification.
- [Geography & Distance](https://docs.tybritelabs.com/tldp/how-tldp-works/geography.md): The distance formula behind every quote and dispatch decision, how the nearest pickup point is found, and the hex grid that narrows a driver search.
- [Request Lifecycle](https://docs.tybritelabs.com/tldp/how-tldp-works/request-lifecycle.md): What happens between your call and the response: authentication, rate limiting, the work itself, and how a retried write avoids creating a duplicate.
- [Dispatch & Fulfilment](https://docs.tybritelabs.com/tldp/how-tldp-works/dispatch.md): How a shipment reaches a carrier — courier assignment and the on-demand offer round — and the states it moves through to delivery.
- [Caching & Resilience](https://docs.tybritelabs.com/tldp/how-tldp-works/caching.md): Which responses are cached and for how long, how revalidation saves a download, the rate limits, and what the API does when something downstream is unavailable.
- [Returns & Reverse Logistics](https://docs.tybritelabs.com/tldp/how-tldp-works/returns.md): The return lifecycle from request to resolution, how the reason decides who bears the cost, and what a refund or an exchange creates.

## API reference

- [API Reference](https://docs.tybritelabs.com/tldp/api-reference/introduction.md): The TLDP REST API — base URL, conventions, and errors.
